evidence: Labeled Wallet and modifies wallet RPC encryption logic in src/wallet/rpc/encrypt.cpp.
rationale: Deprecating `encryptwallet` mitigates fund safety risks and plaintext key leakage caused by encrypting wallets post-creation. As the description notes, encrypting existing wallets invalidates earlier backups risking fund loss on restore, alters spending conditions unexpectedly on manually imported descriptors (#26607), and leaves key remnants on modern disk media.
